camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/resources --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName group --ProductTypes MaxCompute --ResourceTypes MaxCompute --QuotaIds 'quota-k000000da,quota-cd000000w' --PageSize 20 --Verbose true --PageNumber 1 --ResourceName resource --WorkspaceId 123 --VerboseFields 'Quota,IsDefault' --Option ListResourceByWorkspace --Labels 'system.supported.dsw=true,system.supported.dlc=true' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Lists resources associated with a workspace
description_zh: 获取工作空间内已关联的资源列表
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace list-resources --workspace-id 123 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --product-types MaxCompute --group-name group --resource-name resource --option ListResourceByWorkspace --verbose true --resource-types MaxCompute --quota-ids quota-k000000da,quota-cd000000w --labels system.supported.dsw=true,system.supported.dlc=true --verbose-fields Quota,IsDefault --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the workspace. To get the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html.

- This parameter is required if `Option` is set to `ListResourceByWorkspace`.

- This parameter is not required if `Option` is set to `ListResource`
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html。
- 当参数Option为ListResourceByWorkspace时，该参数必填。
- 当参数Option为ListResource时，该参数无需配置
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 资源列表的页码，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: **Deprecated.** This parameter is deprecated. Use the `ResourceType` parameter instead
parameters.help_zh: **该字段已废弃，将会下线，请使用ResourceType字段。**
parameters.name: product_types

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group. To get the resource group name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449143.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源分组名。如何获取资源分组名，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449143.html
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The resource name. The name must meet the following requirements:

- The name must be 3 to 28 characters in length.

- The name must be unique within a region
parameters.help_zh:
资源名。格式为：
- 长度为3~28个字符。
- 同地域内唯一
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en:
The option to query resources. Valid values:

- `ListResourceByWorkspace` (Default): lists the resources in a workspace.

- `ListResource`: lists the resources of the current user
parameters.help_zh:
选项，取值如下：

- ListResourceByWorkspace（默认值）：获取工作空间的资源列表。
- ListResource：获取用户的资源列表
parameters.name: option

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return detailed information. The detailed information includes the `Quotas` field. Valid values:

- `true` (Default): returns detailed information.

- `false`: does not return detailed information
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示详细信息，目前详细信息包含字段Quotas。取值如下：
- true（默认值）：展示详细信息
- false：不展示详细信息
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.help_en:
The resource types. Valid values:

- `MaxCompute`: MaxCompute resources.

- `ECS`: ECS resources.

- `Lingjun`: Lingjun computing resources.

- `ACS`: ACS computing resources.

- `Flink`: Flink resources.

- `SelfManagedAckPro`: self-managed AckPro cluster resources.

- `SelfManagedAckLingjun`: self-managed AckLingjun cluster resources.

- `SelfManagedASI`: self-managed ASI cluster resources from a third-party cloud
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

- MaxCompute：大数据计算服务资源
- ECS：通用计算资源
- Lingjun：灵骏智算资源
- ACS：ACS计算资源
- FLINK：Flink资源
- SelfManagedAckPro：AckPro统一管控集群资源
- SelfManagedAckLingjun：AckLinjun统一管控集群资源 
- SelfManagedASI：ASI统一管控集群资源（三方云）
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en:
A comma-separated list of quota IDs. This operation returns only the resources that are associated with all the specified quota IDs.

> This parameter is available only for resources whose `ResourceTypes` is set to `ACS`
parameters.help_zh:
QuotaId集合，用逗号分割。只有同时具有这些QuotaId的资源才会被返回。


> 目前只有ResourceTypes=ACS的资源才支持用该参数过滤。
>
parameters.name: quota_ids

parameters.help_en:
A comma-separated list of labels. This operation returns only the resources that have all the specified labels.

This parameter is available only for resources whose `ResourceTypes` is set to `ACS`
parameters.help_zh:
Label过滤条件集合，多个条件用逗号分隔。只有同时满足这些标签的资源才会被返回。

目前只有ProductType=ACS的资源才支持用该参数过滤
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
A comma-separated list of fields that you want to return. Valid values:

- `Quota`

- `Label`

- `IsDefault`
parameters.help_zh:
逗号分隔的集合，表明要返回的字段。目前支持：
- Quota
- Label
- IsDefault
parameters.name: verbose_fields
